tone_match.evidence_quote: Right, right, so that's exactly what our dispatch module handles.

price_handling.evidence_quote: I could probably do fifteen percent off if that helps.

objections.why: The rep conceded instead of exploring the concern.

top_misses: No upfront agreement on what the call would cover or decide.
Pitched before understanding the problem in the prospect's own words. See 00:08.
Never got the prospect to put a number on the cost of doing nothing.

rewrite.original_quote: Most teams we talk to struggle with dispatch, so let me show you how we fix that.
rewrite.better_version: Before I show you anything, walk me through what happened the last time dispatch went wrong.

one_thing_to_change: Open every call with a three-part agenda and ask the prospect what they would add.
